goal.summary: He answered with nine items. SIX were shared flow-frame bugs, so at his instruction they became MPI-606 with every root cause traced to the line, and this card kept only the scribble-contained half. completed: TRIAGED FABIO'S NINE ITEMS to root causes, then SPLIT the shared half into MPI-606 (todo/planned, top of board) at his instruction so a separate session can run it in parallel. MPI-606's plan.md carries all six root causes traced to the line plus its file footprint, and names the files MPI-567 holds so neither session reaches across.

THE MISSING PROMPT WAS A BUG, NOT A MISSING FEATURE. The FlowDef carried `positive: 'string'` inside `inputSchema`, and inputSchema is read ONLY for `.media` - a prompt reaches a run by being a declared FIELD with id `positive`. So the flow shipped with no prompt box, and the dead key read as proof it was handled through a review, a green suite and a handoff. Fixed: a `text` field on the paint step, dead key deleted with a comment saying why. The graph needed nothing - node 17 Input_Positive -> StringConcatenate -> CLIPTextEncode was always there.

REVERTED A TWO-SURFACE PROMPT BEFORE IT SHIPPED. Declaring `positive` on the paint step AND the run slide drops edits from the SECOND run onward: gizmo-step fields are role-keyed in _stepValues, flow fields live in _fieldValues, _collectInputs applies the flow store LAST, and after one run s_flowInputs seeds the run-slide copy which then overwrites what the user typed on the step. character-sheet does declare its prompt twice and works ONLY because its prompt step is kind:'fields', a FRAME kind with no role that seeds into the flow store by design. Caught by reading; no test here would have caught it.

TWO MISSING 05-VERIFY GATES CLOSED. tests/inject-params-titles.test.cjs had NO case for this flow despite it carrying more titled injection points than any other; ten Input_* plus Output_Image now pinned, and Input_Positive asserted to STAY titled (the deliberate inverse of Outpaint/Head Swap, which leave that node untitled so an empty injected string cannot clobber a baked instruction). flow-result-compare pins compare:'image1'. Three mutants all RED, files restored byte-for-byte via sha256 in a finally block. 686 tests pass, up from 684.

THE REUSABLE FINDINGS ARE IN docs/, NOT ON THE CARD (Fabio's explicit instruction - cards get deleted, and MPI-596 plus future flows need them). docs/playbooks/add-flow/01-descriptor-and-ops.md gained three sections: a prompt is a FIELD and inputSchema reads only media; a shared field id on a GIZMO step plus the run slide drops edits on run 2; the op key becomes the output filename prefix so renaming is free only before release. existing-flows/scribble-to-object.md's stale 'app half is not started' status is healed and now records every decision below.

ANSWERED, NOT CHANGED: the free-ratio box is correct. It wraps an object PLUS the ground its shadow falls on, never square, and MpiMaskSquareBbox(64) squares it in the graph anyway. Locking a ratio would only deny a subject its shadow room.
pending: RENAME THE OP TO `flowScribObj` (Fabio wrote FlowScribObj; use camelCase to match flowHeadSwap - it yields the same FLOWSCRIBOBJ_001 badge). Mechanical, five files, ALL OURS: js/data/commandRegistry.js, js/core/operationRegistry.js, operation_registry.json, js/data/modelConstants/universal_workflows.js, and the FlowDef's `operation`. FREE because the op is unreleased (appVersionIntroduced 1.5.0 vs released APP_VERSION 1.4.2) so no user has a file named after it - flowHeadSwap (1.1.0) and the two LTX flows (1.4.2) ARE released and must keep their long names. RE-RUN npm test after: the op key is matched by name in several sweeps.

BRUSH TYPES = the ten BRUSH_PRESETS as an MpiDropdown on MpiStepPaint. Fabio meant the History control, which is MpiMaskStrip's (options: BRUSH_PRESETS.map(...)) - the History PAINT tool has none. CHEAP: PaintManager.brushPreset already exists (~73) and the shared dab already honours it (~195-203), so this is a control, not new paint code. Persist it in the step's reported value beside color/brushSize/mode so Reuse restores it.

SHOW THE DOODLE ON THE BOX STEP - ghost or stamped, Fabio said either is fine. MUCH CHEAPER THAN FIRST SCOPED, and this is the finding to not re-derive: both steps declare role 'image1', so they SHARE one _stepValues entry - MpiStepBox already receives the paint layer as props.value.paint and simply does not draw it. NO frame-contract change. Head Swap has no paint sibling so its value.paint is undefined and it is untouched. TAKE MpiStepBox INTO THE CLAIM FIRST - it is not in it yet.

HOLD-SPACE = ZOOM/PAN on the paint step. Overrides an explicit MpiStepPaint ~211 decision ('Fit the whole image into the stage. No pan, no zoom - a step is one gesture') - heal that comment rather than leaving it contradicting the code. BLOCKED BEHIND MPI-606 bug 2: spacebar currently advances a step, so building this first means the two fight.

GRAPHICS DO NOT EXIST and it is not silent - Fabio's console spams repeating 404s for flow-scribble-object.webp and .mp4. All six other flows have both files in comfy_workflows/display/. That is the gradient placeholder and his 'something's missing'. Separate /mpi-flow-graphics pass, and note the filenames follow the flow ID, so do this AFTER the rename settles.

The box step still defaults to the WHOLE IMAGE (the measured worst case). Auto-seeding it from the drawing's alpha bbox is designed and NOT built; showing the doodle may make it unnecessary, so build the ghost first and re-ask.
No reuse round trip, and no live in-app run since the prompt landed - that is 05-verify.md's Definition of Done and it is what closes this card.

At close-out: heal docs/playbooks/add-flow/blending-into-a-photo.md - its headline conclusion and graph-tail section are HISTORY, and its 'under ~2 is invisible' rule needs the dir/cnr split. The three laws behind it all SURVIVED. Also heal this card's acceptance list: it still says 'Canny for a clean structured drawing', but canny's niche is a TONAL drawing.
